subject: BlueCrest POC — exit criteria, trial run plan & final readout scheduling
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-28T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria and owners

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today, Emily — great discussion. Below is a short recap from our discovery and a proposed plan for the 4-week trial so we can align on the final readout timeline.

Recap (2-minute summary)
- Goal: Validate Redwood’s streaming generation + routing to reduce average response latency for BlueCrest triage assistant from ~1.8s to under 700ms while preserving accuracy on intent classification.
- Primary stakeholders: Emily (Clinical Ops), Tom (VP Product), Sarah (Procurement).

Proposed POC scope and success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end response < 900ms for 90% of triage queries (sample workload we discussed).
2) Accuracy/regression: No more than 2% drop vs baseline on intent classification and entity extraction.
3) Stability: Zero incidents exceeding 2x baseline latency during 72h continuous peak-window test.
4) Data controls: Logging retention and redaction per BlueCrest policy (we will present config).

Ownership & timeline
- Redwood owner: Vanessa (POC engineer) — test harness, KV cache config, quant profiles.
- BlueCrest owner: Emily — sample dataset, acceptance prompts, exec readout attendee list.
- Proposed kick-off: 2026-09-02. Trial window: 4 weeks. Final readout (go/no-go) target week: 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-18.

Next steps (action items)
- Emily: confirm success criteria above and provide list of exec attendees for final readout by EOD 2026-08-31.
- Vanessa/Marcus: circulate test plan and operation checklist by 2026-08-31.
- Both: schedule a 30–45m sync to confirm dataset handoff and monitoring hooks (suggest 9/3 or 9/4).

Attachments: bluecrest-poc-success-criteria.docx (draft)

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot record and drop a DocuSign SOW once we’re aligned on dates.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluecrest.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria and owners

Thanks, Soojin — this is clear and a good summary. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- Latency: 900ms at 95th sounds fine as a target for the POC; our bar for GA will be tighter but this is acceptable for trial.
- Accuracy: we’ll pull a labeled sample set (~1,200 queries) and share by 9/2. Can Redwood run the regression baseline against that set?
- Readout: Tom is available during week of 9/14 for an exec-level readout; he prefers mornings PT. Sarah from procurement will join the final meeting for contract alignment.

We confirm the owners on our side: Emily (owner), Tom Alvarez (exec attendee), Sarah Lopez (procurement). We’ll try to get preliminary legal/contract asks to you ahead of the readout so the procurement conversation is productive.

Appreciate the fast follow-up — we’ll firm up the dataset and exec list by 9/2.

—
Emily Chen
Director, Clinical Operations
BlueCrest Health
emily.chen@bluecrest.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluecrest.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: PoC test plan + ops checklist (draft)

Hi Emily / Soojin — attaching the trial run artifacts we discussed. These are draft but ready for alignment:

- poc-test-plan.xlsx — test cases, traffic profile, dataset mapping, measurement queries
- redwood-poc-ops-checklist.pdf — runbook for the 72h peak-window test, monitoring hooks, escalation path

A few operational notes:
- We’ll provide a short SDK for injecting the sample dataset into the test harness; Marcus will own the integration and can validate on a narrowed subset first.
- For the baseline regression, yes — we can run Redwood inference on the labeled set and return per-query diffs and an aggregated report. Expect an initial regression report 48h after dataset handoff.

Can you confirm Sarah (procurement) should receive the SOW draft and DocuSign link ahead of the readout, or would you prefer we wait until after the technical readout? We typically share a one-page fees summary earlier to accelerate procurement review.

Attachments: poc-test-plan.xlsx, redwood-poc-ops-checklist.pdf

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Scheduling the final readout (exec window proposals + contract step)

Emily — thanks for confirming. Per Vanessa’s attachments and our internal schedule, here are two concrete options for the executive-level readout (technical + procurement on the same call):

Option A — Tues 2026-09-14, 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred)
Option B — Wed 2026-09-15, 09:00–09:45 PT

Readout agenda (30–40m)
- 0–10m: POC results — latency and regression summary (Vanessa)
- 10–20m: Stability blast and ops handoff (Marcus)
- 20–30m: Commercials and next steps (Soojin)
- 30–40m: Q&A and decision framing (Tom + Sarah)

Commercial process / DocuSign - I’ll prepare a one-page fees summary and a narrow SOW. If procurement (Sarah) prefers, we can issue a DocuSign envelope ahead of the readout for review; signature would be requested after go/no-go.

HubSpot & logistics - I updated the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BC-HLTH-2026-09
- Would you like a calendar invite now for Option A? I’ll include a Zoom link and the DocuSign preview.

—
Soojin

Option A (Tue 9/14 at 10am PT) works for Tom and me. Sarah will join and has requested the one-page fees summary in advance — she asked that it be sent to her no later than EOD Monday 9/13 so procurement can preview.

Tom will be the decision owner on the call. Sarah will represent procurement and will flag any nonstandard contract terms. Please send the DocuSign preview and the fee one-pager to sarah.lopez@bluecrest.com and cc me.

Also — small ask: can Redwood include a short appendix in the readout deck that lists the specific quantization / routing settings used during the trial? That will help our product team internalize the changes.

Thanks — we’ll have the labeled sample over to you tomorrow morning.

—
Emily
